name: Scar for a Scar / grant-persists-after-own-heal
notes: CR6.6.1c-d: on play, queue a separate layer; life is checked on that layer resolution. No response changes life in this case before that layer resolves. Scar red was played at 18 versus 20, so it gains go again. After reaching ATTACK with empty stack, own Sigil red heals to 21 versus 20. Existing granted go again remains and returns one action point.
